title: Pause the session from the Table header Home control
description:
As a learner, I want a Home control in the Table header that pauses my session, so that I can step away to Home without ending the session I want to continue.

Adds a Home control to the Table header built by E03-S03 (next to Settings and Leave table); E03 does not provide it. Choosing Home pauses the session and opens Home with Resume session (E02-S08). Between hands nothing is lost. Used mid-hand, the unfinished hand is abandoned exactly as when the app is closed (REQ-004.2, REQ-004.6): it is never written, not counted in any statistic, and resuming deals a new hand with stacks as they were before it began. Home never ends the session and never creates a Session Report.

## Requirements covered
- REQ-004 (Must): Pause, resume and end a session — When the user goes Home or closes the app during a session, TLH Trainer shall keep that session as a paused session that can be resumed at the start of the next hand; when the user chooses Leave table, it shall end the session and open the Session Report.

Covers: REQ-004

Plan key: E02-S15 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the Table between hands after hand 10, When the user chooses Home in the Table header, Then Home opens with Resume session showing 10 hands and the session is not ended [REQ-004.9]

Given the session was paused with the Home control after hand 10, When the user chooses Resume session, Then the Table deals hand 11 with every stack equal to its value at the end of hand 10 [REQ-004.9, REQ-004.2]

Given hand 11 is in progress after 10 completed hands, When the user chooses Home in the Table header, Then Home opens with Resume session showing 10 hands and no Session Report is created [REQ-004.9]
Given hand 11 was abandoned with the Home control, When the user resumes, Then a new hand 11 is dealt with every stack equal to its value at the end of hand 10 [REQ-004.9, REQ-004.2]

Given hand 11 was abandoned with the Home control, When stored hand records and the style stats computed from them are read, Then no record of the abandoned hand exists and the stats equal those of hands 1 to 10 [REQ-004.9, REQ-004.6]

Given the Home control on the Table header and paused sessions, When the user presses the browser Back or Forward button on Home, Game Config or the Table, Then the behaviour is decided, documented and covered by a test (e.g. history entries per screen, Back from the Table pauses to Home)

Given a stored session whose nextBotName is above MAX_SESSION_COUNT (1,000,000,000), When it is read for Resume, Then parseSessionRecord rejects it with RangeError 'Invalid session record: nextBotName' and Home stays usable (no mid-session crash on a later bot bust)
